title: Initial Deposit Computation for the Riverbend Self-Pay Outpatient Surgery Package
content:
**Clause 1 — Scope.** This computation settles the initial deposit on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery estimate under Good Faith & Price Estimates, and only that deposit. The enrollment deposit on a maternity and delivery package is not figured by it; on every other package type the deposit paid at scheduling stays the type's deposit percentage of the package price, rounded half-up to the cent.

**Clause 2 — Bookings that owe no initial deposit.** A surgery booking whose patient's award covers the scheduled service date and either is at the Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care or Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL) tier, or carries a hardship liability cap with no cap left, owes no initial deposit and is outside this computation. For this purpose the patient's award is the patient's approved financial assistance case in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a patient holding at most one approved case at a time; the award covers the scheduled service date when that date falls within its award period, which runs from its award start date through its award end date, both counted; the award's cap left is its hardship liability cap less the liabilities already booked on encounters under that case.

| Award covers the scheduled service date | Award tier or cap | Initial deposit owed? |
|---|---|---|
| yes | Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care or Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL) | no |
| yes | a hardship liability cap above zero with no cap left | no |
| yes | any other tier, or a hardship liability cap with cap left | owed, figured under Clause 3 |
| no, or no approved case | any | owed, figured under Clause 3 |

**Clause 3 — The initial deposit.** The initial deposit on a self-pay outpatient surgery package is the deposit percentage of the surgical package price, rounded half-up to the cent. The surgical package price is the sum of the Riverbend facility line and the Riverbend professional line that carry the package's principal service code on the current version of the estimate; co-provider lines, implant lines and every other line of that version are not part of it. The deposit percentage is the deposit percentage of the Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery type in the package deposit schedule.

**Clause 4 — Applying the percentage.** The deposit percentage is one figure, settled in full — any percentage points added to it included — before it is applied; the percentage applied is never more than one hundred percent (100 percent). The product is rounded half-up to the cent once, an exact half cent going up, and the initial deposit is never more than the amount the percentage is applied to.

## Worked figure (hypothetical lines)

| Line on the current version | Amount |
|---|---|
| Riverbend facility line, principal service code | 3200.00 |
| Riverbend professional line, principal service code | 923.45 |
| Anesthesia co-provider line | 610.00 (not part of the price) |
| Implant line | 450.00 (not part of the price) |

Surgical package price: 3200.00 plus 923.45, that is 4123.45. Taking the deposit percentage as 50 percent, the product is 2061.725; rounded half-up once, the initial deposit is 2061.73.
